representation_and_full_complement.review: The API requires all original npw rows, absorbs a rectangular coefficient into the smaller factor leg without changing the dyad, and streams columns only. Potential and ionic actions return all PW rows; neither path projects into saved columns. The gradient reduction likewise contracts the original factor rows and never constructs a PW-square material dyad.
representation_and_full_complement.existing_results: Both rectangular orientations, implicit identity, non-Hermitian square coefficients, nonorthogonal frames, nineteen-column streaming, block partitioning, and empty factors pass their recorded comparisons. full_complement_action, complement_cross_dyad_density, and complement_cross_dyad_gradient pass. The saved-span projection and dropped complement-cross-dyad mutations are exposed, with recorded max_abs_error 0.03689293183175582 and 0.0031189698889245057 respectively.

bilinear_transpose_not_adjoint.review: The local reduction uses the inverse Fourier transform of density without conjugating it. The pilot contracts potential and direction by dot rather than vdot; the conjugated right factor belongs to the definition of X, not to the test field. For the wider right leg, multiplication by coefficient.conj().T is precisely what preserves X after the right leg is adjointed.
bilinear_transpose_not_adjoint.existing_results: The oracle separately records bilinear density/potential and ionic transpose comparisons, genuine conjugate-adjoint comparisons using X dagger, and wrong-adjoint mutations for each of its five dyad cases. Every recorded check passes. Explicit adjoint identities and coefficient/direction-conjugation sensitivity also pass.

positive_gradient_and_both_projector_sid.review: The nonlocal reduction keeps the independently differentiated bra and ket terms with their opposite phase derivatives and returns the complex positive derivative. No real-part extraction, force minus sign, or factor of two is inserted. The old action consumer retains both terms too. The prepared-model consuming loops sum the returned gradients explicitly and apply the force minus sign at the force boundary; total_force_probe supplies its own minus sign and separately conjugated adjoint action.
positive_gradient_and_both_projector_sid.existing_results: Independent analytic projector placement is differentiated with SymPy before comparison. The oracle records primitive local and nonlocal checks, each coordinate's full action, and independent missing-bra and missing-ket mutations. Recorded mutation max_abs_error values are 0.015196121045229018 and 0.02392239786710937. Native-real-part, native-factor-two, and force-minus-sign mutations are all exposed.

coordinate_order_and_input_identity.review: The constructor checks grid dimensions, zero k/q, PW momenta and FFT row slots, species atom maps, table volume, D, and placed projector identity for every original atom. Species-group nonlocal contractions scatter back to original zero-based atom indices and flatten atom-major xyz; the local reduction uses that same ordering. ionic_action reshapes the incoming atom-major vector to nat by 3. The actual consumer binds original atoms 1..37 and both spins; the saved-map dispatch rejects missing, duplicate, or inconsistent spin keys instead of silently dropping them.
coordinate_order_and_input_identity.existing_results: The finite fixture uses noncontiguous species order Ni,H,Ni and compares every coordinate. The recorded omitted-z-coordinate, mismatched-geometry, wrong-volume, non-Gamma, and truncated-row controls pass. Actual archives declare complex gradient and direction shapes [111], original positions [3,37], and retained atom identities, alongside full-row action shapes [18613,2].

physical_quadrature_and_spin.review: PhysicalRhoFFT reconstructs amplitudes with the unnormalized inverse convention and normalized forward convention. The dyad density includes 1/Omega, and its integration measure is Omega/Ngrid; the potential action consequently needs no extra volume factor. Both collinear spin channels are raw/unweighted. The accepted background's total/magnetization-to-up/down conversion remains at its existing boundary; new mean/tangent consumers explicitly route each channel to its density component and apply the declared sector weight once. Regional-number readout obtains physical quadrature through the potential-action trace and uses the explicit measure only for held density.
physical_quadrature_and_spin.existing_results: The finite oracle's integrated traces and volume-measure checks pass; mutations removing volume normalization, inserting unitary density normalization, or doubling the gradient are exposed. Actual two-spin integrated-trace and density/potential comparisons pass without inserting spin degeneracy.
